$comment: The only place a hostname is written. `base_domain` was bought at LiveDNS and the staging CNAMEs were created 2026-08-26; the staging hosts below are the custom subdomains (swapped 2026-08-27) and app/core/cors.py builds the credentialed-request allowlist from them. The frontends additionally need the api host BAKED IN at build time as VITE_API_ORIGIN (a Railway service variable on each static service — see web/packages/core/src/identity/session.ts), so a host change here means setting that variable to match and redeploying the three apps. Production hosts stay PENDING until production services exist; HB-domain's production half stays open until then.
